title: [master] Bin Capacity Policy "Prohibit More Than Max. Cap." fails and allows more than the maximum Capacity, when you split lines on Inventory Movement
summary: Fixed bin capacity enforcement in non-directed warehouses so that registering partial inventory movements now correctly prevents bins from exceeding maximum capacity limits.
key_points: Bin Capacity Policy 'Prohibit More Than Max. Cap.' was incorrectly allowing overflow when splitting inventory movement lines in basic warehouses
Root cause: cubage and weight calculations were only performed for directed locations, leaving zero values in basic warehouse entries
Solution adds cubage/weight calculation via WMSMgt.CalcCubageAndWeight for non-directed warehouse movements
Warehouse entries now properly carry cubage data so capacity checks can validate against maximum limits
Includes test coverage for the scenario
